Chapter 513: Chapter 12 Great Scholar Tai’e: When did you become a great scholar too? (Please subscribe)

“Go invite the Galaxy Master…”

The other Eighth Layer invincible Evolvers glanced at each other.

Battlefield B0001 is the oldest medium-sized battlefield,

gathering a large number of Evolvers from human civilization and strong individuals from the Tianyu Clan.

In terms of the intensity of war, Battlefield B0001 is second only to the Large Alien Battlefield,

often witnessing battles among Eighth Layer invincible beings; the number of Eighth Layer invincible beings deployed by human civilization in this battlefield even exceeds several dozen.

...

Moreover, aside from the Eighth Layer invincible beings, there are also Ninth Rank powers paying attention.

Of course, whether it is from the side of human civilization or the Tianyu Clan,

Ninth Rank powers only pay attention and basically do not intervene.

Once Ninth Rank powers enter the fray, the nature of the battle shifts, and the entire battlefield could be decimated.

The alliances of several peak clans in the cosmic starry skies restrict the actions of Ninth Rank powers as much as possible, except in large battlefields, where it is rare for Ninth Rank powers to act.

Previously, when human civilization dispatched multiple Ninth Rank Evolvers to purge several powerful clans within the Insect Race Alliance, it was because the Insect Race had openly severed diplomatic ties.

“Inviting the Galaxy Master, that indeed is a solution…”

Many of the Eighth Layer invincible Evolvers nodded in agreement,

Being Eighth Layer invincible, they are naturally extremely proud, but they harbor no doubts about the Galaxy Master.

In that battle within the Milky Way Star Region, the Galaxy Master, facing five opponents alone, killed two of the Eighth Layer invincible from different species,

With such ferocity, which Eighth Layer invincible would dare to harbor other thoughts?

The Galaxy Master, through his own power, raised the combat power limit of Eighth Layer invincibles,

and even shattered the myth of their invincibility, being acclaimed as the first Eighth Layer Evolver of human civilization,

or more precisely, the foremost Eighth Layer Evolver in the history of human civilization.

“But, what price should we pay to invite the Galaxy Master?” asked a woman in blue robes.

With the strength of the Galaxy Master, there indeed was hope to turn the tide of the battlefield, at least to hold off a significant portion of the Eighth Layer invincibles of the Tianyu Clan.

Under such circumstances, human civilization would be virtually unbeatable.

All that is well and good.

The problem is what kind of price to pay.

If the price is too low, the Galaxy Master would not bother to come.

If the price is too high… then there is no upper limit, and they are also unclear exactly how high a price would be necessary to invite the Galaxy Master.

“I’ve decided… to yield one-tenth of the total merit points from the upcoming wars in this battlefield…” a short, plump figure pondered for a while and said earnestly.

“One-tenth of the total merit points?”

The many Eighth Layer invincible Evolvers were shocked.

The total merit points from a battlefield involve a very large number of merit points.

Why do those Star Lords of star domains continually seek to take over and manage one alien battlefield after another? Merely to serve human civilization?

Of course, because managing an alien battlefield can yield substantial benefits, among which merit points are the most important aspect.

“As long as we can hold our own against the Tianyu Clan, let’s yield it.”

The Eighth Layer invincible Evolvers pondered for a while and agreed.

Losing the war against the Tianyu Clan, for those Eighth Layer invincible Evolvers who reside permanently on the battlefield, would also require a huge price, perhaps even losing this avatar.

“In that case.”

“Then I will contact the Goddess of Freedom, who will reach out to the Galaxy Master.”

The short, plump figure spoke.

Mobilizing an Eighth Layer invincible, especially a legendary Eighth Layer invincible like Lin Yuan, certainly requires the approval of the Goddess of Freedom.

Simultaneously, the price they agreed upon also needs to be certified by the Goddess of Freedom, which is also a way to express their sincerity to the Galaxy Master.

…

Demon Jade Space.

Second Layer of the Black Tower.

Lin Yuan’s form reappeared, an invisible yet profound pressure assaulting him from all directions.

“Confronting the enveloping pressure with various cosmic forces, could it help me develop more techniques of utilizing cosmic forces?”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Ever since his last failed attempt at conquering the Second Layer of the Black Tower, he occasionally re-entered the Nine Floors Dark Tower using the Magic Jade Mark.

By utilizing the pressure of the Second Layer, he trained in the use of various cosmic forces.

In the Main World, for beings of the Eighth Layer, cosmic force is unique, so there are simply no techniques for its utilization.

But in the Spirit Realm, many Supreme Immortal Kings mastered various powers of creation, and the combination of different creative powers could often unleash even greater might.

The internal environment of the Nine Floors Dark Tower, especially designed for cosmic force and understanding of space rules, combined with Lin Yuan’s Against-Heaven’s Understanding, could completely allow him to better grasp the techniques of utilizing cosmic forces through continuous adjustment and adaptation.

Of course, Lin Yuan’s visits here were merely considered a pastime during his periods of comprehending space rules; he would come here to relax whenever he felt tired.

Outside the Nine Floors Dark Tower.

The Stone Statue Shen Ji was also observing Lin Yuan’s performance on the second layer.

“This young fellow, treating the training ground left by the master as a stepping stone?” the Stone Statue Shen Ji shook its head.

“But it’s good, I’m indeed looking forward to what achievements you might have in the future.” Stone Statue Shen Ji stared at the screen featuring Lin Yuan.

A moment later.

Lin Yuan voluntarily gave up.

Expelled from the Nine Floors Dark Tower, he appeared outside the Black Tower.

“How’s it going, kid?” the Stone Statue asked with a smile.

“Got some insights,” Lin Yuan said, though in fact, it was more than just some; he had just concretely realized six types of cosmic force techniques, including three advanced cosmic forces.

“Fully sensing the essence of cosmic force will greatly benefit the ultimate sublimation and transformation of your inner world into an inner universe,” the Stone Statue Shen Ji stated.

“Inner universe…”

Lin Yuan’s expression became slightly solemn.
